content: David, Salomónʼga napi-igar-uksad
David e-burgwed-ibagan modanigusadgi, e-machi-Salomónʼga igar-uknai gusad. Weyob ega sogsad:
“Anmar we-burgwed-igar itogedsesoggu, we-napneggi-naega an-ibagan modanikid, gandik be imako, machered be san-sao.
Bab-Dummad-Jehová-Igar-Uksadba be ibsao, e-Igar-Maidba be nanao:

content.text: We-Igala, Moisés-gardagi narmakar mamaid. We-Igarmar-Mamaidba be daele, be nueganbi nasgumai guoed.

content: ”Deun, Bab-Jehová anga sogsa gusad: ‘Be-sorba be-wagan-danimaloedi, an-asabin neg-itoakwaa-nanamalale, e-ulubgine innikigwadba an-Igar-Mesisadba ibmar-imakmalale, Israel-yargi, be-sorba be-wagan-negsemaloed surguosurye.’

”Emisgindi be nue-wisid, Sarvia-machi-Joabʼye-nugadi, bila-onolenaiyob yogasaar Israel-sorda-bur-dummagan-ebogwad-oburgwis gusad. Joab, Ner-machi-Abnerʼye-nugad-ibe ablis-eos gusad, degi, Jeter-machi-Amasaʼye-nugad-ibe ablis-eos gusbalid. Deyob, Joab e-molidub-e-dikargi-naid, degi, e-sapat-yoid abebi imaksa gusad.
Degisoggu, be-binsaed-nikadba be imako: Melle Joab-sereddii-megega be imako.
”Barzilai-masmala Galaad-neggweburginmalad, bela be wiledakdii nanao. Beba-mas-gunmalaga be imako, ar ade, be-ia-Absalónʼgi an dukudigu, wemar nue-an-bendaksad.

”Aginbali, an Mahanaim-neggweburse nadapgu, Simei sabesur-an-ukabsanai gusad. Simeiʼde Gera-e-machid, Benjamín-wagwad, Bahurim-neggweburginedid. Simei, Jordán-diwargi an-abindakapgu, Bab-Jehová-nuggine Simei-oburgosurye an sogsa gusanad.
Degi-inigwele, mer be Simei-dula-gudii imako. Be-binsaed-nikadba be imako, na be wisid, igi be Simei-imakoe, melle be a-dule baisur-dako. Ar Simei seredgusad-inigwele, sabsur-imakar be oburgo.”
David-burgwisad
David burgwenonikid. Geb e-neggwebur-eba-nugadgi e-sergan-neg-uan-maid-dikarba digsamalad.
David Israel-yar-naidgi birga-dulabo (40) negsesad: Hebrón-neggweburgi birgagugle (7) negsemai gusad, degi, Jerusalén-neggweburgi birga-dulagwen-gakambe-gakapaa (33) negsesbalid.
Geb Salomón, e-bab-David-sorba rey-gangi signonikid, nabir bonisuli negsemai gusad.
Salomón e-yar-semaid gangumai gusad
Geb Haguit-machi-Adonías, Salomón-e-nan-Betsabé daknaded. Betsabé, Adoníasʼga sogded: —¿Nuedgi be daniki? Adonías ega sogdemogad: —Eye, nuedgi an danikid.
Geb Adonías sogdebalid: —Ibmar-soggwen an bega sogbi. Betsabé ega sogded: —Degite, soge.
Adonías ega sogded: —Be wisid, we-yar-naid, angadinad, Israel-dulemar e-reyga-megega an-edarbismalanad. Emisgindina, Bab-Jehová-sogedba, an-urba-Salomónʼga uklenonikid, egadga gunonikid.
Nabir. An bese ibmar-soggwen egis. Mer be anga suli sogena gadin. Betsabé ega sogded: —Soge.
Adonías ega sogdebalid: —Wilesagwadgi an bega soge: Rey-Salomónʼbogwa be sunmaknae, anga Sunam-neggweburgined Abisagʼye-nugad ukega, an nikuegar. Ar Salomón begardi surye sogosulid.
Betsabé abin-sogded: —Nabir. An be-ular reyse sunmaknao.

Betsabé, Adonías-ese-ibmar-egichadba, Rey-Salomón-daknaded, ebo sunmakegar. Rey-Salomón, e-nan-abin gwichibin-imaksad. Geb abin dulluu imaksabalid. Geb Salomón e-nan-osiega, gan-dummad sedagega imaksad. Reydi gannar e-gangi sigisad. Geb Salomón-e-argan-nuedsik e-nan sigisad.
Agi, Betsabé sogded: —Ibmar-soggwen an bese egisbie. Mer suli be anga sogena gadin. Rey abin-ega-sogded: —Be egise, ar be an-nanad, ibu be anse egisbie, an bega ukodo.
Betsabé ega sogdesun: —Be-ia-Adoníasʼga Abisag-Sunam-neggweburgined be uke, adi, nikuegar.

Salomón, e-nan-abin sogded: —¿Ibiga be Adoníasʼga Abisag-egise? Unnila we-yar-naid ega be egisedbi napi an be-dakdo, emide an-ia-Adoníasʼga be Abisag-egisnaigu. Deginbali, dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-goled-Abiatarʼye-nugad, Salomónʼba-naid, degi, Sarvia-machi-Joabʼye-nugad eba-naimogad.
Rey-Salomón Bab-Jehová-nuggi ise-sogar-imaksad: “Adonías we-ibmar-egichadba burgwesulile, Bab-Dummad sabsuli an-odurdaksunno.

Degisoggu, Bab-Jehová an-ogannononikid, an-bab-David-gangi reyga an-osisad. Aginbali, an-sorba negsemaloed surguosurye anga sogsabalid. Degisoggu, Bab-Jehová-Dula-Maid-nuggine an soged, emi Adonías burgoye.”
Agi, Rey-Salomón, Adonías-oburgwega Joiada-machi-Benaíaʼga igar-uksad. Adonías-amidapgua, oburgwissunnad.

Rey-Salomón dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-goled-Abiatarʼgardi, sogded: “Anatot-neggweburse be nae, be-nainumar-naidse. Ar be oburgwelemogadinad, degi-inigwele, emidi, an be-oburgosulid. Ade, an-bab-Davidʼga be Bab-Jehová-Bur-Dummad-Maid-Ulu sedigusad-nukad an be-oakalogosulid. Aginbali, an-bab-David-bonigan-itosad, deun eba be itodii gusmogad.”

Salomón deyob dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-golleged-igargi Abiatar-onosad. Ade, Bab-Jehová, epenne Silo-neggweburgi, Elí-e-neguyanik sunmaksa gusad: “Elí-e-neguyagi dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-goled an osulogoye.”

Joab, Absalónʼba nai gussulid, degi-inigwele, Adoníasʼbardi nai gusad. Degisoggu, Joab wisgunonigu, Adonías burgwisye, agi, Joab Bab-Jehováʼse-goled-dordonegse wakite gusad. Geb ibmar-ogumakar-ukleged-ailagi moli-bebeyob-gwichidgi akas nagusad.

Salomón-owisosmalad, Joab Bab-Jehováʼse-goled-negse wakiteye, ibmar-ogumakar-ukleged-aila-naba gunaye. Agi, Salomón Joiada-machi-Benaía-barmisad. Weyob ega igar-uknai gusad: “Joab-gunaidse be nao, geb be Joab-oburgo.”
Benaía Bab-Jehováʼse-goled-negse dogdapgua, Joabʼga sogded: —Rey soged: ‘Be magaba-nondaye.’ Joab abin-sogded: —Suli. An wegi burgoe. Benaía, Rey-Salomónʼga sognonikid, igi Joab e-abin-imaksa.

Rey-Salomón, Benaíaʼga sogded: —Igi Joab bega sogsa, deyob be imako. Be Joab-oburgo, geb be digbalo. We-Joab binsarsunna emar-ablis-eosadgi an-nug-gasad, an-gwenadgan-nug-gasbalid. Geb weyob magar-daklenonikoed, Amasa-oburgwilesadi, degi, Abner-oburgwilesadi, anmarginsurye.

Joab igar-maisulidba yogasaar dule-warbogwad-eba-bur-inniki-gudimalad oburgwisad. An-bab-David-wissuli, Joab es-suidgi emar-oburgwenaigusad. Joab, Ner-machi-Abner-oburgwisad, degi, Jeter-machi-Amasa-oburgwisbalid. We-Abnerʼde, Israel-sordamar-e-dummadinad. Amasaʼdi, Judá-sordamar-e-dummadmoganad. We-ebogwad ibmar gwen oakalossurmarsoggu, a-ulale, Bab-Jehová buged-mai Joab-imakoed.

”Degisoggu, Joabʼgi wemar-ebogwad-ablis-eolesad ataklegoed, degi, e-wagan-e-sorba-danimaladgi degisadegu ataklemogoed. Davidʼgardina, Bab-Jehová neg-bogidikid ukoed. Bab-Jehová, David-waganga neg-bogidikid ukmogoed, e-wagan-reyga-megmaloedga neg-bogidikid ukbaloed, geb e-negseoedgi amba neg-bogidik imakbaloed.”
Joiada-machi-Benaía Joab-gunaidse naded. Geb egi gwisgudapid, agi Joab-oburgwisad. Geb nega-dulesulidganba e-neg-siidse Joab-dikapmalad.
Rey-Salomón sordamar-e-dummadga Joiada-machi-Benaía-nug-imaknonikid. Degi, Abiatar-anar dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-goledga Sadoc-nug-imaknonibalid.
A-sorba, Rey-Salomón Simeiʼse-gornamalaga emar-barmisad. Geb Simei nonigu, ega sogded: —Be Jerusalén-neggweburgi na be neg sobo, mer be yogasaar aineba nao.
Ar be Cedrón-diwar-maidgi obakdedibe, be wisigar, be oburgwilegoed. Na be dukin imako.
Simei reyga sogded: —Nabir. Dummad-rey, be-sogedba an imako. Degisoggu, Simei Jerusalén-neggweburgi undar gudii gusad.
Birgapaa-nasgu, Simei-mai-warbogwad Gat-neggweburse Maaca-machi-Rey-Aquisʼse wakicha gusmalad. Dule-gwensak Simei-owisosad, ega sognonikid: “Be-maiga-gudimalad Gat-neggweburgi-gudimarye.”

Agi, Simei e-maiga-gudimalad-amiega naded, geb e-moli-uayasuid-birgi nakwisad. Geb Gat-neggweburse nade gusad, Aquis-maidse. Degidgine, Simei e-maiga-gudimalad Gat-neggweburgi-gudii amisgu, gannar sealid.
A-sorba, Salomónʼga sognonimalad, Simei Jerusalén-neggweburgi nade gusye. Gat-neggweburse atakapye, geb gannar Jerusalén-neggweburse noniye.

Agine, Salomón, Simei-sedamalaga imaksad, geb ega sogded: —Bab-Jehová-nuggi, be anga ise-sogar-sogega an be-imaksasursi, mer be Jerusalén-neggweburgi nooye. Nue-ise-sogar an bega sogsabarsursi: ‘A-ibagi be nosdibe, ase be arbidibe, be-oburgwilegoye.’ Be nue anga sogsamogad: ‘Nabiri, an beba ibsaoye.’
Degite, ¿ibiga be deyob Bab-Jehová-asabin ise-sogar-sogsad be imaksasuli? An bega igar-mesismogadba be imaksasurbalid.
Aginbali, Rey-Salomón Simeiʼga sogdebalid: —Be ebinsao, an-bab-Davidʼgi be nue-isgus-gusad. Degisoggu, emisgindi, Bab-Jehová bega nunmaked-ukmogoed, na be dukin boni-amisad.
Angardi, Bab-Jehová ibmar-nued ukoed, Bab-Jehová David-e-negselemaid innikigwadba selegega imakoed, degi-selemai sadeguoed.
Agi, Rey-Salomón, Joiada-machi-Benaíaʼga sogsad, Simei-oburgweye. Geb Benaía Salomón-sogedba imaksad, Simei-oburgwisad. Salomón deyobi bela yar-ganonikid.
